_comment: Entries may be latest aliases (codex/latest[-sol|-terra], claude/latest-opus|sonnet|haiku, qoder/<tier>@latest) resolved at dispatch; see plugins/routing/resolve.mjs. Default provider order per task type (section 24b capability bench, 05-11). A caller may override the provider and the gate. A busy or failed entry moves to the next one. Each entry is provider/model as the daemon config names them (see `paseo provider models <id>`). Copy to routes.local.json and replace <REPO_GATE_COMMAND> and the gate rows.
